Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by ongoing uncertainty around Nvidia's leadership. Jensen Huang's situation is the real driver, creating an overhang for your concentrated chip and tech names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-74.27%), MUU (-54.71%), and SPAL (-45.53%) are deep in the red, amplified by margin. SMCI (-39.33%) is also a major concern. These leveraged ETFs are decaying and need immediate attention.

Bottom line: Your heavy concentration in leveraged tech/chips, especially with the Nvidia uncertainty, demands tight risk management.
plays: SOXL: Consider tightening your stop from 200 to a level closer to the current price of 57.83 to limit further downside on this -74.27% position.
MUU: Review and adjust your stop from 31.6, as this leveraged ETF is down -54.71% and its default stop is far from the current price of 16.84.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The current market sentiment around key tech names suggests caution over initiating new long positions.
